net_banking.name: Net Banking
net_banking.description: Authenticate using your bank's internet banking User ID, Password, and OTP.

debit_card.name: Debit Card
debit_card.description: Authenticate using your 16-digit debit card number, expiry date, CVV, and OTP.

pan_cust_id.name: PAN / Customer ID
pan_cust_id.description: Authenticate using your PAN card number or Customer ID and OTP sent to registered mobile.

aadhaar_online.name: Aadhaar Online
aadhaar_online.description: Authenticate via NPCI Aadhaar OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.

aadhaar_simple.name: Simplified Aadhaar
aadhaar_simple.description: Authenticate using your Virtual ID or masked Aadhaar number and OTP.

step_scripts.language_selection: {customer_name}. Welcome to eMandate registration. Please choose your language 'English' or 'Hindi'.
step_scripts.intro: I am an automated assistant calling on behalf of {company_name}. I'll guide you through your e-mandate registration it will take 2 to 3 minutes. Shall we proceed?
step_scripts.auth_mode_selection: Please Say 1 for Net Banking, 2 for Debit Card, 3 for PAN or Customer ID, 4 for Aadhaar Online, or 5 for Simplified Aadhaar. Which option do you prefer?
step_scripts.review_mandate: On the form open on your screen, you should see your name, bank account number, EMI amount, and dates. Please verify — are all your details correct?
step_scripts.npci_redirect: The page is redirecting to NPCI's secure server. Has the NPCI page loaded?
step_scripts.npci_checkbox: On this page there is a checkbox at the bottom for Terms and Conditions. First tick that checkbox, then click Submit. Have you clicked Submit?
step_scripts.bank_login: The secure login page of your bank should now be open. Carefully enter your Net Banking User ID and Password.  Please use the same credentials you use to log in on your bank's official website or app. Once you have logged in, please say 'done' or 'completed'. I'll wait here.
step_scripts.debit_card_entry: Now enter your Debit Card number, expiry date, and CVV on screen and click Submit. CVV is on the back of your card — a 3-digit number. After submitting, please say 'done'.
step_scripts.pan_cust_id_entry: Now enter your PAN number or Customer ID on screen and click Submit. PAN is 10 characters. Customer ID is on the first page of your passbook. After submitting, please say 'done'.
step_scripts.aadhaar_online_entry: Now enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number on screen, select the OTP option, and click Send OTP. Once you have clicked Send OTP, please say 'done'.
step_scripts.aadhaar_simple_entry: For Simplified Aadhaar, please enter your virtual ID or masked Aadhaar number on the screen. You will receive an OTP on your Aadhaar-linked mobile. After entering the details, please say 'done'.
step_scripts.otp_entry: An OTP will arrive from your bank on your registered mobile number. Enter it on screen and click Submit. Once the OTP is submitted, please say 'done'.
step_scripts.processing_hold: Excellent! The page is now processing — please do not close the browser or press back for 10 seconds. The page will automatically redirect on its own. Has the page changed or a new page appeared?
step_scripts.success: Congratulations! Your eSign e-mandate is successfully complete! Please note your UMRN number.
step_scripts.closing: Thank you! Have a wonderful day!
step_scripts.wait: No problem, I will wait. Say 'I am ready' when you want to continue.
step_scripts.npci_loading_wait: Please hold for a moment. Check your internet connection. The NPCI page should load shortly. Let me know when you see the NPCI logo at the top.
step_scripts.otp_wait: I understand. Please wait 30 seconds and check if your mobile has good network coverage. You can also try clicking Resend OTP on the bank page. Let me know once you receive the OTP so we can continue.
step_scripts.intro_rejection: No problem at all. The link stays active for 15 days — you can open it and complete it yourself whenever you are ready. Call us if you need any help. Thank you, have a great day!
step_scripts.processing_hold_long: Great. Please hold for 10 seconds and do not close your browser. The page is now redirecting back to the summary page.
step_scripts.exit_message: No problem at all. You can always complete this later using the same link. Thank you for your time, have a wonderful day!
step_scripts.rejection_callback_offer: No problem! Would you like us to call you back at a more convenient time to help you with this, or should we end the call for now?
step_scripts.empty_input: I'm sorry, I couldn't hear you. Could you please say that again?
step_scripts.fallback_response: I'm not sure I understood. Could you please repeat or rephrase that?

step_scripts_hindi.language_selection: {customer_name}. Welcome to eMandate registration. Please choose your language 'English' or 'Hindi'.
step_scripts_hindi.intro: Main {company_name} ki taraf se ek automated assistant bol rahi hoon. Main aapke e-mandate registration process mein guide karungi. Isme lagbhag do se teen minute lagenge. Kya hum shuru karein?
step_scripts_hindi.auth_mode_selection: Authentication complete karne ke liye kripaya apna option choose karein. Net Banking ke liye ek bolein, Debit Card ke liye do bolein, PAN ya Customer ID ke liye teen bolein, Aadhaar Online ke liye chaar bolein, aur Simplified Aadhaar ke liye paanch bolein. Aap kaunsa option choose karna chahenge?
step_scripts_hindi.review_mandate: Aapke screen par jo form khula hai, usme aapka naam, bank account number, EMI amount aur dates dikh rahe honge. Kripya teen cheezon ko verify karein Kya aapki saari details sahi hain?
step_scripts_hindi.npci_redirect: Page NPCI ke secure server par redirect ho raha hai. Kya NPCI page load ho gaya?
step_scripts_hindi.npci_checkbox: Is page par neeche ek checkbox hoga — Terms and Conditions ke liye. Pehle woh checkbox tick karein, phir Submit button dabayein. Kya aapne Submit button daba diya?
step_scripts_hindi.bank_login: Ab aapke bank ka secure login page khul chuka hoga. Yahan apna Net Banking User ID aur Password dhyan se enter karein. Yeh aapka ATM PIN nahi hai — wahi credentials use karein jo aap bank ki official website ya app me login karne ke liye use karte hain. Jab login ho jaye toh 'ho gaya' ya 'kar diya' bolein. Main yahin wait kar rahi hoon.
step_scripts_hindi.debit_card_entry: Ab screen par apna Debit Card number, expiry date, aur CVV enter karein aur Submit dabayein. CVV card ke peeche hota hai — 3 digit ka number. Submit karne ke baad 'ho gaya' bolein.
step_scripts_hindi.pan_cust_id_entry: Ab screen par apna PAN number ya Customer ID enter karein aur Submit dabayein. PAN 10 character ka hota hai. Customer ID aapki passbook ke pehle page par hoti hai. Submit karne ke baad 'ho gaya' bolein.
step_scripts_hindi.aadhaar_online_entry: Ab screen par apna 12 digit Aadhaar number enter karein aur OTP option select karke Send OTP dabayein. Send OTP dabane ke baad 'ho gaya' bolein.
step_scripts_hindi.aadhaar_simple_entry: Simplified Aadhaar ke liye, kripya apna virtual ID ya masked Aadhaar number daalein. Aapko apne Aadhaar-linked mobile par ek OTP milega. Details daalne ke baad 'kar diya' bolein.
step_scripts_hindi.otp_entry: Aapke registered mobile number par bank se OTP aayega. Woh enter karein aur Submit dabayein. OTP submit karne ke baad 'ho gaya' bolein.
step_scripts_hindi.processing_hold: Bahut achha! Ab page process kar raha hai — please 10 second tak browser band mat karein aur back button bhi mat dabayein. Page khud hi agle page par redirect ho jayega. Kya page badal gaya ya koi naya page aa gaya?
step_scripts_hindi.success: Congratulations! Aapka eSign e-mandate successfully complete ho gaya! UMRN number note kar lein.
step_scripts_hindi.reentry_prefix: Haan, toh jaisa ki main keh rahi thi:
step_scripts_hindi.wait: Koi baat nahi, main wait karungi. Jab ready ho to 'ready hoon' bolein.
step_scripts_hindi.unclear: Maaf kijiye, main samajh nahi payi.
step_scripts_hindi.npci_loading_wait: Kripya thoda wait karein. Apna internet connection check karein. NPCI page thodi der mein load ho jayega. Jab aapko upar NPCI ka logo dikhe, toh mujhe batayein.
step_scripts_hindi.otp_wait: Main samajh sakti hoon. Kripya 30 second wait karein aur dekhein ki aapke mobile mein network sahi hai ya nahi. Aap bank page par Resend OTP par bhi click kar sakte hain. Jab aapko OTP mil jaye toh mujhe batayein taaki hum aage badh sakein.
step_scripts_hindi.intro_rejection: Koi baat nahi. Yeh link 15 din tak active rahega — aap jab bhi ready hon, ise open karke khud complete kar sakte hain. Agar koi madad chahiye ho toh humein call karein. Dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho!
step_scripts_hindi.processing_hold_long: Bahut badhiya. Kripya 10 second wait karein aur browser band mat karein. Page ab wapas summary page par redirect ho raha hai.
step_scripts_hindi.exit_message: Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Aap baad mein phir try kar sakte hain usi link se. Aapka din shubh ho! Dhanyavaad.
step_scripts_hindi.rejection_callback_offer: Main samajh sakti hoon. Kya aap chahte hain ki hum aapko baad mein call karein, ya phir abhi call end kar dein?
step_scripts_hindi.empty_input: Maaf kijiye, main aapki awaaz nahi sun payi. Kya aap phir se bol sakte hain?
step_scripts_hindi.fallback_response: Mujhe samajh nahi aaya. Kya aap dobara bol sakte hain?
